      5. Plug & Drive Studio 3

      Plug & Drive Studio 3 —  For motor controllers/drives and motors with integrated controller/drive

      Plug & Drive Studio 3 is a software used to commission and program Nanotec’s motor controllers/drives. This software version comes with an integrated UI Designer which enables users to adapt the interface to different types of applications and user groups.

      With the help of Controlbrowser it is also possible to quickly develop and integrate customized modules. The modular project management supports multi-axis systems as well as copy/paste and the import/export of function modules.

      Fieldbus interfaces: USB, CANopen, Modbus RTU, Ethernet (REST), EtherCAT 

      Latest Version 3.3.0.2

      • Download(s) 3.3.0.2 (zip, 160 MB)
      • Operating Systems Windows 10 x64, Windows 11 x64
      • Firmware Firmware Package (zip, 112 MB)
      • Manual Plug & Drive Studio 3 - User Manual v. 1.4.0 (pdf, 2 MB)
      • Compatible Products
        Smart Servos – Motors with integrated controller/drive Motor controllers/drives for BLDC and stepper motors

      You can find older software versions in our archive.

      Webinar: Introducing Plug & Drive Studio 3

      Our free Plug & Drive Studio 3 makes programming and commissioning Nanotec motor controllers / drives even more intuitive! This video provides insights into the software’s features and demonstrates how you can efficiently develop and integrate your own modules.
